reference_note: This file freezes the documentary comparison target used by BAII.4. It does not freeze or modify Phase 3A or Phase 3B scientific design.

f3a_supporting_sources.role: Frozen F0-F2 reference set inherited by the Phase 3A entry contract
Current Phase 3A workflow status and pre-design bibliographic gate

f3b_supporting_sources.role: Accepted program decision defining Phase 3B as realistic injection-recovery plus independent held-out validation
Frozen B001-B009 correction-development and validation requirements

F3A_COHORT_UNIVERSE.project_reference: Prospectively defined catalogue-scale observational cohort; source catalogue(s), eligibility criteria, cohort construction, inclusion/exclusion, duplicates/repeated observations and observational roles/strata must be frozen before execution.
F3A_COHORT_UNIVERSE.source_locator: Phase 3A scientific role; Required prospective design

F3A_CATALOG_SCALE.project_reference: Catalogue-scale observational robustness extending the frozen ten-event F2 pilot to a substantially broader prospectively defined observational cohort.

F3A_EVENT_SELECTION.project_reference: Event eligibility, cohort construction, inclusion/exclusion, duplicate handling and provenance/selection of QPP-labelled or comparison events must be defined prospectively; candidate discovery is not authorized.

F3A_QPP_CLASSIFICATION_REFERENCE.project_reference: QPP-labelled/comparison-event provenance and selection rules must be independent of the F3A output; F3A cannot establish physical truth, sensitivity/specificity, observational false-positive rate or true-negative status.

F3A_WINDOW_ROBUSTNESS.project_reference: Temporal-window dependence is a primary observational-robustness dimension; future F3A must freeze temporal-window perturbations rather than silently inherit the F2 grid.
F3A_WINDOW_ROBUSTNESS.source_locator: Phase 3A scientific role; Required prospective design

F3A_PROCESSING_ROBUSTNESS.project_reference: Dependence on processing choices is a primary observational-robustness dimension; processing profiles must be explicitly frozen prospectively.
F3A_PROCESSING_ROBUSTNESS.source_locator: Phase 3A scientific role; Required prospective design

F3A_QUALITY_AND_GAPS.project_reference: Admissibility and failed/missing execution handling must remain explicit; input inadmissibility is not non-selection. The future design must freeze an admissibility contract and missingness/failed-execution handling.
F3A_QUALITY_AND_GAPS.source_locator: Frozen scientific inheritance; Required prospective design

F3A_NUMERICAL_STABILITY.project_reference: Classification robustness and optimizer behaviour are separate evidence planes. Optimizer-seed policy and numerical diagnostics must be frozen; warnings, bounds, convergence limitations and numerical multiplicity remain reportable. Stable classification does not demonstrate a unique numerical optimum.
F3A_NUMERICAL_STABILITY.source_locator: Frozen scientific inheritance; Required prospective design

F3B_INJECTION_RECOVERY.project_reference: Phase 3B is reserved for realistic injection-recovery and independent held-out validation.

F3B_SYNTHETIC_GROUND_TRUTH.project_reference: Explicit synthetic ground truth is required for classification and period; observational roles must not be treated as physical truth.

F3B_SIGNAL_FAMILIES.project_reference: No final signal-family design is currently frozen. BAII.4 should identify literature signal families that may be relevant prospectively to realistic injection-recovery.

F3B_NOISE_BACKGROUND.project_reference: No final noise/background design is currently frozen. BAII.4 should characterize literature noise/background choices relevant to realistic injection-recovery without treating them as adopted project design.

F3B_SELECTION_FUNCTION.project_reference: Any correction/performance program requires explicit known truth and prospectively defined success criteria; selection/recovery performance belongs to Phase 3B rather than observational F3A.

F3B_DEVELOPMENT_VALIDATION_SPLIT.project_reference: Formal development and validation sets must remain explicitly separated; validation cannot be partitioned post hoc after designing the rule.

F3B_HELDOUT_VALIDATION.project_reference: An independent held-out benchmark is required, and any corrective rule evaluated confirmatorily must be defined before access to held-out validation data.

F3B_BASELINE_COMPARISON.project_reference: Any new rule must be compared with the frozen baseline without modifying historical baseline results.

F3B_CLASSIFICATION_VS_PERIOD.project_reference: Classification and period are separate outcomes; period is interpretable only when selection survives unless a different outcome definition is prospectively justified.

comparison_guardrails.note: BAII.4 may characterize descriptive overlap and prospective impact categories only. The formal F3A gate decision remains reserved for BAII.5.
